patterns.root_cause: Services and utilities directly extract and use error.message without governance wrapper, exposing raw error details to clients/callers

examples.code: const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error";
examples.context: catch block returning error to client

examples.code: error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)

required_fix.service_layer: Replace with classifyOperatorError(error, { context: 'load' }) then use classified.operatorMessage
required_fix.single_line_conversion: const classified = classifyOperatorError(error, { context: 'load' }); return { error: classified.operatorMessage };

patterns.risk_notes: Services may have custom error handling logic; each file requires individual review to ensure context parameter is appropriate

patterns.root_cause: Error creation/throwing logic in runtime and services does not apply governance classification before exposing errors
patterns.code_pattern: return new ErrorClass(message, {...}) without prior classifyOperatorError

required_fix.approach: Apply classifyOperatorError to error source BEFORE RuntimeError instantiation, or modify RuntimeError to accept pre-classified errors
required_fix.single_line_approach: const classified = classifyOperatorError(error, { context: 'load' }); return new RuntimeError(classified.operatorMessage, {...});
required_fix.architectural_decision: May require reviewing RuntimeError constructor to accept governed errors

patterns.risk_notes: RuntimeError is a factory; changes may affect error propagation across the system. Requires careful testing of error handling paths.

notes.scope: Only service/utility layer (src/services, src/runtime, src/infra, src/middleware, src/lib, src/domain). NO API routes (R29 completed). NO UI/pages (per user NO UI WORK instruction).
notes.classification_caveat: User asserted api_real_defects=0, ui_real_defects=0. This registry assumes those counts are correct and focuses exclusively on service layer.
notes.bulk_regex_prohibition: Each fix must target specific lines/patterns, not use find-replace across files.
notes.build_tsc_requirement: After EACH pattern fix, npm run build and npx tsc --noEmit must pass before committing.
